Who We Are

An engineering company built on integrity, delivery & skilled people.

Natwecraft Investments Private Limited is an EPC (Engineering, Procurement & Construction) company providing comprehensive solutions for the Water, Wastewater, Energy and Land Development sectors in Zimbabwe. What began as a power engineering and equipment hire business has grown — through the diversity of our key management team and strategic partners — into civil, mechanical and electrical engineering delivery at scale.

Our Vision

To be the leading civil and power engineering solutions company in Sub–Saharan Africa by year 2050.

Our Mission

To grow and be dedicated to achieving results by aligning our products with customer needs — conducting business with integrity while building sustainable relationships with clients, stakeholders and employees.

Our Objectives

Fulfil and exceed customer expectations; remain cost effective without compromising quality; capitalise on opportunities to increase productivity, create employment and support our communities.

What We Do

Full-scope EPC delivery across water, energy and land.

From treatment plant rehabilitation to substation commissioning and serviced residential stands, our in-house team and strategic partners cover the full project lifecycle — engineering, procurement and construction.

01

Water & Wastewater Treatment

Construction and rehabilitation of water and wastewater treatment plants, pump stations and reticulation networks for municipal clients.

02

Land Development

Residential, industrial and commercial land development — servicing virgin land with sewer, water, tarred roads, public lighting and electricity reticulation.

03

Transformer Installation & Maintenance

Transformer installation, rigging, maintenance and oil filtration services for power utilities, mines and industrial clients.

04

Substation Construction

Substation construction, commissioning, circuit breaker & isolator installation, earthing rehabilitation and protection system upgrades.

05

Earthmoving Equipment Hire

Graders, excavators, backhoes, front-end loaders and TLBs available for hire to mines, contractors and government projects.

06

Lifting Equipment Hire

Mobile cranes and forklifts for hire — supporting mining, industrial and construction lifting requirements across Zimbabwe.

Signature Capability

Rehabilitating the plants that keep water flowing.

Our civil, electrical and mechanical teams have delivered long-term rehabilitation works on the City of Bulawayo's wastewater treatment infrastructure — including the Aisleby and SAST plants — in joint venture with international specialist Veolia Water Solutions and Technologies.

  • Civil, electrical & mechanical rehabilitation works
  • Sewer pump station construction & commissioning
  • Joint venture delivery with international water specialists
  • Ongoing BWSSIP works funded by the African Development Bank

Who We Serve

From Bulawayo to Hwange — sectors that keep Zimbabwe running.

Our outreach stretches over Bulawayo, Harare, Kariba, Hwange, Kwekwe and Beitbridge, serving energy utilities, mining houses and local government.

Energy Sector

Zimbabwe Power Company (ZPC), Zimbabwe Electricity Transmission and Distribution Company (ZETDC), and Helcraw Electrical.

Mining Sector

Mbada Diamonds, Zimplats, Mimosa Mine, Hwange Colliery Company, RHA Tungsten Mine and Sabi Gold Mine.

Local Government

Bulawayo City Council, Empumalanga Local Board and Nkayi Rural District Council.

Key Management

Led by experienced engineering & finance professionals.

The company prides itself on experienced engineering and technical personnel, complemented by skilled and casual staff engaged on a project basis.

NM

Nkululeko Bruce Moyo

Operations Manager
